entry.name: rnbo_notein
entry.description: Receives its input from a MIDI note-on or note-off message sent by a MIDI input device.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: A number in the right inlet will set the MIDI channel for notein. A value ofor lower will receive MIDI note messages on all channels.
